newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-U.S. Robotics EPS trimmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-U.S. Robotics EPS trimmed.

text.p: --Oppenheimer & Co Inc analyst Stephen Levy said he trimmed his estimate for U.S. Robotics Corp's fiscal second quarter by $0.04 to $0.78, citing an expected increase in sales and marketing expenses as the company rolls out its new x2 high-speed modem technology.
--Oppenheimer also trimmed the estimate for the 1997 fiscal year by $0.05 to $3.45 a share, but maintained the estimate for fiscal 1998 at $4.70.
--Levy said he continues to rate the company a buy.

--"We continue to urge investors to jump on board the U.S. Robotics x2 train before it pulls out of the station," Levy said in a statement. U.S. Robotics is due to begin shipping its new desktop modems in the next couple of weeks and the network systems in February.
